meta_data.base_class: Search for <messages> from specific users containing certain keywords - refers to various types of social or communication messages.

tool_template.name: search_<class>_messages
tool_template.description: Search for <class> messages from specific users containing certain keywords.

user_name.description: The name of the user whose <class> messages are being searched.

keyword.description: The keyword to search for within the <class> messages.

start_time.description: The start time for the <class> message search in ISO 8601 format.

end_time.description: The end time for the <class> message search in ISO 8601 format.

include_attachments.description: Whether to include <class> messages with attachments in the search results.

priority.description: Filter <class> messages based on their priority level. Options include 'high', 'normal', and 'low'.

limit_results.description: The maximum number of <class> messages to return in the search results.

language.description: Specify the language of the <class> messages to search for. One of: 'English', 'Spanish', 'Chinese', 'French', 'German', 'Japanese', 'Korean', 'Russian', 'Portuguese', 'Arabic'.
